title: U Mass - Electrolytes
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xwafpae
materials: Allow reagents and assay plate to come to room temperature. Gently remove well contents and wash plate 2x following the instructions listed in the Plate Washing section.
Add 25 μL of Detection Antibodies into each well. Allow the Detection Antibodies to warm to room temperature prior to addition.

steps.title: Initial Plate Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the plate wells and mix at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of Wash Buffer into each well of the plate.
Seal and mix on a plate shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).

steps.title: Remove Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Decant the Wash Buffer and remove residual liquid from all wells by inverting the plate and tapping it smartly onto absorbent towels several times.

steps.title: Add Standards, Controls, and Samples
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate standards, controls, and samples to the wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 μL of each Standard or Control solution into the appropriate wells (use Assay Buffer for 0 pg/mL standard/Background).
Add 25 μL of Assay Buffer to the sample wells.
Add 25 μL of Sample (diluted one part serum or plasma to one part Assay Buffer) into the appropriate wells.
Note: Use provided Serum Matrix for serum/plasma samples, or proper control culture medium for tissue culture/supernatant.

steps.title: Add Beads and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add mixed beads to the plate and incubate overnight.

substeps.instruction: Vortex Mixing Bottle and add 25 μL of the mixed or premixed beads to each well, shaking the bottle intermittently to avoid settling.
Seal the plate with a plate sealer.
Wrap the plate with foil and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker overnight (18~20 hours) at 4°C.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 1 hour at room temperature (20~25°C).
Do not aspirate after incubation.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Add the detection reagent and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 μL Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well containing the 25 μL of Detection Antibodies.
Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C).

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Gently remove well contents and wash the plate 2x using the Plate Washing procedure.

substeps.instruction: Let plate soak on magnet for 60 seconds to allow complete settling of magnetic beads.
Remove well contents by aspiration.
Wash plate with 200 μL/well of Wash Buffer.
Allow beads to soak for 60 seconds, and remove Wash Buffer by aspiration after each wash.
Repeat wash steps as recommended. (If using Bio-Tek ELx405 plate washer, follow equipment settings).

steps.title: Resuspend Beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in Sheath Fluid.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 μL of Sheath Fluid to all wells.
Resuspend the beads on a plate shaker for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Run Bioplex 200
steps.instruction: Run the plate on the Bioplex 200 system.

substeps.instruction: Set parameters for 125 µl and 75 beads per bead set.
Save and analyze the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) data using a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve-fitting method.
For diluted samples, multiply the calculated concentration by the dilution factor.
